CH4-01.changes: Composition retained: podium/ballroom left, paired facilities center, broad service access right; small NPCs remain simple. Lamps/chandelier supply local warm light, window fill stays cooler, and recesses/under-duct shadows deepen. Curved shaded duct, irregular heavy drapes, separate stone/carpet/wood and existing wear clusters are reconstructed at 314×206.
CH4-01.knownLimitations: Still a compact stylized reconstruction. Large stone/plaster surfaces and the existing flower silhouettes remain simpler than the detailed reference and strongest Chapter 2 work. Lower service recess is deliberately dark; Nate should judge object visibility.

axes.Logical dimensions: Same native grid as approved artwork: 314×206 scene, 564×278 portrait layers. No enlargement to make room faces detailed.
axes.Detail density: v03 spends the budget on surface light and form rather than additional decorative objects. Bureau and Control Tower remain the primary room references; approved receptionist supplies the close-up minimum target.
axes.Silhouette clarity: v02 layout, paired facilities and small NPC silhouettes remain. Foreground is independently rebuilt with curved contours and the established silver hair, burgundy costume and gavel.
axes.Color clusters: Native material/volume fields replace large flat fills; light is grouped locally. There is no whole-image palette-count quota, quantization or source pixel sampling. Some transitions remain visibly procedural.
axes.Architectural edges: Cast/contact shadows and recess values add depth to the same doors, duct, panels, windows and podium; moldings do not substitute for surface modeling.
axes.Object readability: Restroom sightline, podium, door hardware, piano connection and service corridor remain. Owner should judge the darker service recess and small flower clusters at 1×.
axes.NPC scale/simplicity: Main-scene people retain single face clusters and small bodies. Portrait adds rounded face/hair/hands at a separately authored native scale; no character raster is reused between grids.
axes.Native/4\u00d7 craft: All three candidates, matching v02 images and approved references are provided at native and exact 4×. v01 and original detailed references remain available unchanged; 4× does not confer visual approval.

CH4-02.changes: Same close camera, architecture and empty foreground. Warm lamp light, cooler ambient fill, curtain/contact shadows, rounded tarnished duct, modeled velvet folds and darker doorway/wood give the surfaces separate light responses.
CH4-02.knownLimitations: Material lighting is procedurally evaluated from authored native geometry. Some surfaces can look cleaner and more smoothly shaded than the approved receptionist background; the wear and velvet finish still need creative comparison.
